item.title: Building Books from Markdown
item.description:
Our books are written as ordinary Markdown files. A small build system turns those files into formats that are easier to read, share, or upload: EPUB for e-readers, DOCX for Word-compatible editors, HTML for a web browser, and ODT for LibreOffice.

You do not need to understand the internal machinery to use it. Usually, you write your chapters, open a terminal in the book folder, and type one short command:

item.title: Easter Bunny Bandits Finale
item.description:
These are the media files from the Easter Bunny Bandits Finale by BoundSakura and ThifanyJohnSt. I bought the deviation and make them available here as a ZIP download and via Google Drive.

Downloads:

  • Download Easter Bunny Bandits.zip
  • Open the Google Drive folder

The original text says:

The “Easter Bunny Bandits” were arrested on Friday and no one has heard from them since. After finding out @zoec98 and @katied-life were working together to frame them, will they be able to save Easter or will it be a candy-less year?
